lines.text: Never take a hotel key to Room 0.
lines.say: Never take a hotel key to Room Zero.

lines.text: Midnight check-in. The clerk slid me a key.
Room 0. No floor. No number. Just zero.
lines.say: Room Zero. No floor. No number. Just zero.

lines.text: The fire map showed rooms 1 to 20. No Room 0.
lines.say: The fire map showed rooms one to twenty. No Room Zero.

lines.text: But at the end of the hall, there was a door.
The bed was still warm. Like someone just left.
At 3 AM, the room phone rang.
lines.say: At three A.M., the room phone rang.

lines.text: Front desk: Whatever you hear, don't open the door.
Then someone knocked. Then everyone knocked.
Through the peephole, the hall was full of guests.
Every one of them was holding a key to Room 0.
lines.say: Every one of them was holding a key to Room Zero.

lines.text: At dawn I ran to the lobby. The clerk was gone.
Only his name tag on the desk. My name.
So, welcome. Here's your key. Room 0.
lines.say: So, welcome. Here's your key. Room Zero.
